title: HR Specialist/ (Full-Time, Remote – Philippines)
description:
Company Overview

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. The ideal candidate must be independent, empathetic, proficient in employee communication, and familiar with employee risk management. You need to be process-driven, meticulous, and capable of adapting to a fast-paced remote working environment. Candidates with Chinese language proficiency will be given priority consideration.



Key Responsibilities

1. Full-cycle Recruitment: Publish job openings, screen resumes, conduct interviews, coordinate hiring processes, and complete talent matching according to department staffing demands.

2. Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage employee onboarding, job transfer, status adjustment, resignation and termination procedures; organize and file employee documents to ensure complete and standardized personnel files.

3. Performance Management: Assist in optimizing performance appraisal systems, organize regular performance evaluations, sort assessment data, follow up on performance feedback, and complete data statistics.

4. Employee Relations: Maintain daily communication with employees, respond to HR-related inquiries, properly handle daily employee relation issues, and build a positive team atmosphere.

5. Training & Employee Care: Organize employee onboarding training and deliver HR policy training; arrange one-on-one employee interviews and emotional counseling, track staff dynamics, and improve employee retention rate.



Qualifications & Requirements

1. Minimum 2 years of solid HR working experience, familiar with recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and performance management processes.

2. Proficient in employee relations management, skilled in one-on-one counseling, emotional guidance, staff care and training.

3. Strong data sorting ability, rigorous and detail-oriented in daily work.

4. Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills to communicate with all-level employees.

5. Self-motivated and responsible, capable of independently handling full-cycle HR tasks.

6. Proficient in Office software, able to make training materials and maintain employee relation records.

7. Must have backup internet such as prepaid WiFi/data for stable remote working.

8. Must have a power backup in case of power outages.

9. Shift arrangement: Day shift for the first month, then transfer to night shift permanently.

10. Ability to speak and understand Chinese is a bonus qualification.



Application Guidelines

1. Your updated resume (resume link is acceptable).

Candidates who pass the initial screening will be contacted via email for an interview invitation. Wish you all the best.

title: Graphic Designer (Slot Games & Brand/Logo Design)
description:
About the role



We build original slot games for the Stake Engine platform (
) and do logo/brand work for a range of companies. We're looking for a versatile hands-on graphic designer to own the visual identity across both — game art, animation, and UI, plus clean, memorable logos and brand assets.



You will be the person who makes our game look and feel premium studio releases and who will give client brands a distinctive mark. You'll work closely with a developer who integrates your assets into the live game, so a spec-driven, collaborative approach matters.



What you'll do



Slot game art & animation (primary focus)

Design full slot game visuals: symbols, board frames, backgrounds, and feature screens (bonus rounds, big-win 
nts).

Create animations — symbol wins, cascading/tumbling effects, multipliers, feature intros, transitions — using Spine 2D (skeletal) and/or sprite-sheet animation.

Style game UI (buttons, panels, counters, win displays) into a cohesive look.

Produce marketing game tiles (background, foreground/hero, provider logo) to platform spec.

Optimize every asset for web — packed texture atlases, transparent PNGs, and a lean overall bundle (load speed affects a game's rating and placement).

Hold a cohesive art direction per game — a consistent, professional style across symbols, board, backgrounds, UI, and animation.





Brand & logo design (ongoing)

Design logos and brand identities — original marks that are distinctive, versatile, and legible at all sizes (favicon to billboard).

Produce logo variations (full/stacked/icon, light/dark, monochrome) and simple brand guidelines (colour, type, usage).

Deliver clean vector source files plus exported raster/web formats.

Turn briefs into polished concepts, present options, and refine from feedback.





Must-haves

A portfolio showing your visual strengths — illustration, game art, logo/brand work, or a mix. You don't need to cover everything; show us what you're great at.

Strong illustration and composition — a symbol set that reads instantly, a logo that works at 16px.

Adobe Illustrator + Photoshop (or equivalent).

2D animation: sprite sheets and/or Spine 2D.

Web/game asset optimization (atlases, compression, transparent PNGs).

100% original work — no AI-generated or stock assets (platforms auto-reject them).

Reliable, self-directed, and able to work to a spec.





No casino/gaming experience needed — each game comes with a detailed art brief.



Nice to have: Figma, After Effects, PixiJS, particle/VFX tools, game UI/UX.



To apply: Send your portfolio and a one-line note on a favourite project. To confirm you read this, start your message with the word REEL.

title: Sales Lead/Manager
description:
JVDB Studios | Amsterdam, Netherlands



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Hours: 20 hours per week to start (Part-Time) with the opportunity to scale to 40 hours per week based on performance

Time Zone: Must have overlap with European/CET business hours

Compensation: Competitive base salary + uncapped commission



About JVDB Studios



JVDB Studios is a media and technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We are the team behind some of the world's largest creator brands, including Kwebbelkop and BlooGaming, which collectively reach more than 15 million subscribers globally.



Our CEO has built multiple successful digital businesses, generated billions of views across platforms, and continues to expand into new ventures within content, technology, licensing, and media distribution.



We are looking for a highly driven Senior Sales Manager / Commercial Lead who can take ownership of revenue-generating relationships across the business and work directly with the CEO to drive growth.



The Opportunity



This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for a proven closer who can build opportunities from scratch, develop relationships with decision-makers, and personally close deals.



You will own the full sales cycle across multiple business lines and play a key role in helping scale the company internationally. This role begins as a part-time position at 20 hours per week. Candidates who demonstrate strong execution, ownership, and the ability to consistently generate and close opportunities will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at 40 hours per week.



We believe in rewarding results. As you help grow the business, the role will grow alongside you.



What You'll Be Responsible For



You will own all revenue-generating relationships across the group, including brand partnerships, media licensing opportunities, FAST and OTT distribution partnerships, DubDash new business development, and creator service partnerships.



You will be responsible for building and managing your own pipeline, conducting outbound prospecting, qualifying opportunities, leading discovery and sales calls, creating proposals, negotiating commercial terms, closing deals, and ensuring a smooth handoff to operations. You will also maintain CRM accuracy, provide regular reporting, forecast revenue, and proactively identify risks and opportunities.



This position reports directly to the CEO with a dotted reporting line to the COO.



What We're Looking For



We are seeking someone with at least four years of B2B sales or business development experience and a demonstrated personal track record of closing consultative, multi-week sales opportunities. You should be able to show real numbers and revenue results from deals you have personally closed.



You must be comfortable owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close and be confident communicating with senior decision-makers across Europe, the United States, and the Middle East. Near-native business English, both written and verbal, is essential for this role.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-motivated, accountable, and capable of building systems and opportunities from scratch. We are looking for a self-starter who can operate independently while maintaining strong communication with leadership.



Candidates with experience in SaaS, media, creator economy businesses, content licensing, FAST channels, OTT distribution, or high-ticket B2B services will be viewed favorably, although these are not required.



This Role Is Not For You If



Your recent career has focused primarily on managing sales teams instead of personally closing deals. You have experience only in appointment setting or SDR roles without a proven closing record. You rely on company logos or network connections rather than demonstrated sales performance. You require a fully built-out system, extensive support, or a large team in order to succeed.



Why Join JVDB Studios



This is a unique opportunity to work directly with a founder who has built audiences of more than 15 million subscribers and multiple successful digital businesses. You will have direct access to leadership, exposure to international clients and partnerships, and the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the commercial future of a rapidly growing media company.



You will work in a fully remote environment with a Monday-to-Friday schedule and collaborate with partners and clients across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. The role offers uncapped commission potential and a clear path from a part-time position into a full-time opportunity for individuals who consistently deliver results.



How to Apply



Subject Line: JVDB Sales Manager



Send your updated resume along with a short Loom video introducing yourself and discussing your sales experience. In your video, please share examples of deals you have personally closed, the types of clients you have worked with, and any sales metrics or achievements you are proud of.



Please send your application to:







Only candidates with a proven track record of personally closing deals will be considered.

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer for E-Commerce Growth
description:
Meta Ads Media Buyer for E-Commerce Growth



Job Title

Expert Meta Ads Media Buyer – Scale E-Commerce ROAS from 2.57x to 5.5x



Job Description



About Us



Geurwolkje is a fast-growing aromatherapy e-commerce brand selling premium essential oils and diffusers to consumers in the Netherlands and Belgium. We're scaling rapidly through Meta Ads
 & Instagram and need a talented media buyer to help us optimize our advertising efficiency to the next level.



Current Situation:



Monthly Ad Spend: €13,000

Current ROAS: 2.57x

Target ROAS Phase 1: 3.5x in 4 weeks

Target ROAS Phase 2: 5.5x in 8 weeks



The Challenge



We've identified three major bottlenecks in our account that need immediate optimization:



Hook Uniformity & Audience Fatigue

Many of our ads use the same messaging "RESET15", causing audience fatigue and lower CTR. We need someone who understands that the same video with 4 different psychological hooks Sleep, Stress Relief, Seasonal Reset, Social Proof can reach different audience segments and significantly reduce CPA.

Funnel Drop-Off in High-Traffic Campaigns

One campaign generates 1,120 Add to Carts but only 173 purchases 76% drop-off. This is a Value Optimization problem—we're attracting clickers, not buyers. We need someone who can diagnose and fix this.

Inefficient Retargeting

Our retargeting campaign has the worst ROAS 1.96x and highest CPA €23.82 of all campaigns. It should be our most profitable. We need strategic fixes: exclude recent buyers, strengthen the offer, and use better messaging.



What You'll Do



Daily Responsibilities:



Monitor KPIs ROAS, CPA, CTR, Frequency every morning

Pause underperforming ads CPA more €25 immediately

Scale winning campaigns by 20–30% weekly

Test and implement hook variations on existing UGC videos

Manage ad set optimization and bidding strategies

Adjust targeting and exclusions based on performance data



Weekly Responsibilities:



Analyze which hooks perform best and consolidate winners

Duplicate top-performing ads and test new messaging angles

Shift budget allocation toward high-ROAS campaigns

Send performance reports with insights and recommendations



Strategic Responsibilities:



Implement Value Optimization on funnel-problem campaigns

Consolidate overlapping ad sets to reduce CPM

Build and manage retargeting campaigns with proper exclusions

Scale the account from €13,000 to €19,500+ monthly spend while improving ROAS



Required Skills & Experience



Must-Have Non-Negotiable



2+ Years Meta Ads Management

Proven experience running
 & Instagram campaigns

Deep understanding of Conversions vs Value Optimization bidding strategies

Knowledge of frequency caps and audience fatigue prevention

E-Commerce Expertise

Experience managing ads for e-commerce businesses

Understanding of the full funnel: Awareness ? Consideration ? Conversion

Experience fixing Add to Cart ? Purchase drop-off issues

Data-Driven Decision Making

You make decisions based on data, not intuition

You can analyze and interpret ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, and frequency metrics

You set hard rules e.g. CPA more €25 = pause immediately and follow them consistently

Meta Ads Manager Proficiency

Comfortable navigating Meta Ads Manager

Can duplicate ad sets, adjust budgets, modify targeting

Understand Meta's learning phase and know when to leave settings alone

Hook & Creative Variation Understanding

You understand that the same video with different copy/hooks can reach different segments

You know how to A/B test messaging angles not just creatives

Experience with UGC campaigns is a plus



Nice-to-Have



Experience with aromatherapy, wellness, or beauty products

Familiarity with Dutch/Belgian markets

Google Analytics and UTM tracking knowledge

Experience with Shopify or similar e-commerce platforms



What Success Looks Like



Week 1–2 Target: 3.0x ROAS



Scale winning campaign by 20%

Implement Value Optimization on funnel-problem campaign

Launch 4 hook variations on Best UGC campaign

Fix retargeting exclusions and messaging



Week 3–4 Target: 3.5x ROAS



Pause all ads with CPA more €25

Consolidate top 2 performing hooks

Shift 50% of budget to winners

Achieve 3.5x ROAS target



Week 5–8 Target: 5.5x ROAS



Consolidate overlapping ad sets

Shift 70% of budget to highest-ROAS campaigns

Launch aggressive retargeting push

Scale account spend to €19,500+ while maintaining 5.5x ROAS



Key Performance Indicators KPIs You'll Track



What We're NOT Looking For



Tweak Junkies: We don't want someone who changes settings daily. Respect for Meta's learning phase is essential.

Creative Visionaries: We're not looking for someone to make videos or handle creative direction. That's our job.

Generalists: We need a specialist in Meta Ads, not someone who does a bit of everything.

Impatient People: This is a 4–8 week optimization journey. We need consistency and patience.



Metric Targets



Account ROAS more 3.0x ? Pause expensive ad sets

Campaign CPA less €18 ? Pause individual ads

Link CTR more 1.0% ? Refresh creative/hook

Frequency 7-day less 3.5x ? Expand audience or refresh

Spend pacing on budget ? Adjust daily budgets



How We'll Work Together



Full Access: You'll have complete access to the Meta Ads account

Weekly Reporting: Send brief performance reports every Friday with metrics, actions taken, and recommendations

Real-Time Communication: We're available for questions and strategic discussions

Data-Driven Decisions: All decisions are based on performance data, not opinions



Compensation & Project Details



Project Type: Ongoing with potential for long-term partnership

Duration: 4–8 weeks with possibility to extend

Commitment: 15–20 hours per week flexible scheduling

Budget: Your Budget Range negotiable based on experience

Payment Terms: Weekly or bi-weekly your preference



Application Requirements



To apply, please provide:



Your Upwork Profile with portfolio links

2–3 Case Studies of Meta Ads campaigns you've optimized include before/after metrics

Answers to These 4 Questions:

Describe a Meta Ads campaign where you reduced CPA by 20%+. What was the problem? What did you do? What was the result?

You have 5 UGC videos of aromatherapy diffusers. Design 4 different hooks/copy angles you'd test. Explain why each hook targets a different audience segment.

A campaign has 1,200 Add to Carts but only 180 purchases. What's the problem? How would you fix it? What bidding strategy would you use?

You're given 10 ads with their ROAS and CPA. Which would you pause? Which would you scale? Why?

Your Availability: When can you start? How many hours per week can you commit?



Why Work With Us?



Clear Goals: You know exactly what you need to achieve ROAS 3.5x ? 5.5x

Full Data Access: You get detailed weekly analytics and insights

Autonomy: You have complete control over the account and decision-making

Growth Opportunity: As ROAS improves, budget grows, and you scale the account

Long-Term Potential: Excellent opportunity for ongoing partnership with a growing brand



Questions?



Feel free to message me on Upwork. I'm happy to discuss the account details, your experience, and how we can work together to achieve these ambitious goals.



Let's grow Geurwolkje together!



Note: This is a performance-based role. Your success directly impacts our business growth, and we're committed to working with someone who is equally committed to excellence.

title: Sales & Acquisitions Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Sales & Acquisitions Manager is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and securing real estate investment opportunities that align with the company's acquisition strategy. This role oversees lead generation, seller outreach, property underwriting, broker relationships, and transaction coordination while ensuring a consistent pipeline of qualified investment opportunities.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, results-driven, and comfortable communicating with property owners, real estate professionals, lenders, and internal stakeholders. This position requires strong negotiation skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple acquisition activities simultaneously.

________________________________________

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Lead Generation

• Generate qualified acquisition leads through multiple channels, including:

o Auctions

o Pre-foreclosures

o Tax foreclosures

o Probate properties

o Vacant properties

o Absentee owners

o Tired landlords

o Expired listings

o FSBO (For Sale By Owner)

o MLS and off-market opportunities

o Direct referrals

o Public records and online lead sources

• Continuously research and identify new lead generation opportunities.

• Maintain an organized acquisition pipeline.

________________________________________



Seller Outreach & Lead Management

• Conduct outbound cold calls to property owners and prospective sellers.

• Manage SMS marketing campaigns and follow-up communications.

• Respond promptly to inbound seller inquiries.

• Qualify leads based on company acquisition criteria.

• Schedule appointments and coordinate property discussions.

• Maintain detailed notes and communication history within company systems.

________________________________________



Broker & Realtor Relations

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with brokers and Realtors.

• Communicate regularly regarding investment opportunities.

• Request comparable sales, market insights, and property information.

• Coordinate property showings and inspections.

• Expand the company's referral network.

________________________________________



Property Underwriting & Financial Analysis

• Analyze investment opportunities using company underwriting guidelines.

• Review comparable sales, market trends, repair estimates, and exit strategies.

• Prepare acquisition analyses and investment summaries.

• Calculate:

o ARV (After Repair Value)

o Purchase price recommendations

o Estimated renovation costs

o Holding costs

o Closing costs

o Profitability projections

• Prepare Net Sheets and acquisition recommendations for management review.

________________________________________



Negotiation & Acquisitions

• Negotiate purchase terms with sellers, agents, wholesalers, and other stakeholders.

• Assist in preparing Letters of Intent (LOIs), purchase agreements, and related acquisition documents.

• Coordinate contract execution and document collection.

• Maintain consistent communication throughout the acquisition process.

• Escalate complex negotiations to executive management when necessary.

________________________________________



Due Diligence

• Coordinate property inspections and contractor walkthroughs.

• Verify ownership, title information, taxes, liens, and other encumbrances.

• Review available legal documents and public records.

• Assist in coordinating appraisal, valuation, and lender requirements.

• Ensure acquisition files are complete and properly documented.

________________________________________



Marketing & Campaign Management

• Coordinate SMS and direct marketing campaigns.

• Assist with cold calling initiatives and lead generation campaigns.

• Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements.

• Maintain accurate marketing lists and lead databases.

________________________________________



Reporting & Pipeline Management

• Maintain accurate acquisition trackers and CRM records.

• Provide daily, weekly, and monthly acquisition reports.

• Track:

o New leads generated

o Calls completed

o SMS campaign performance

o Qualified leads

o Active negotiations

o Contracts pending

o Closed acquisitions

• Present acquisition pipeline updates to executive leadership.

________________________________________



Systems & Documentation

• Maintain organized acquisition files and documentation.

• Ensure all communications, contracts, underwriting analyses, and reports are properly stored.

• Update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as acquisition processes evolve.

• Maintain data accuracy across company systems.

________________________________________



Continuous Improvement

• Stay informed on local real estate market conditions and investment trends.

• Recommend improvements to lead generation strategies and acquisition processes.

• Identify opportunities to improve workflow efficiency and conversion rates.

• Support implementation of new acquisition tools, software, and automation.

________________________________________



QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience in real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, sales, or investment analysis preferred.

• Strong negotiation and communication skills.

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

• Comfortable making outbound cold calls and conducting seller outreach.

• Experience with SMS marketing platforms, CRM systems, and lead management software.

• Knowledge of property valuation, underwriting, and investment analysis.

• Ability to interpret comparable sales and market data.

• Proficient in Microsoft 365, Excel, SharePoint, and project management tools.

• Self-motivated with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

- Develop Persuasive Copy: Write clear, compelling, and persuasive sales copy for a variety of outbound and inbound channels, including
 campaigns, cold outreach, website, and social media. 

- Understand Target Audience: Conduct research to understand the pain points, needs, and desires of our target audience, thereby producing relevant customer personas and journeys. 

- Implement Effective SEO Practices: Conduct keyword optimisation and create customer-centric website copy to attract and engage potential customers. 

- Conduct Competitor Analysis: Study the copywriting techniques of our competitors in their various channels for inspiration and best practices, and make informed decisions on improving our own channels. 

- Create Engaging Content: Develop attention-grabbing subject lines, headlines, and calls to action that encourage engagement and conversion. 

- Master the Company’s Product/Service: Build a deep understanding of the features of our product/service in order to integrate it into effective copywriting. 

- Collaborate with Lead Gen and HubSpot Teams: Work closely with the Lead Gen and HubSpot teams to align copy with overall strategies and goals. 

- Optimise for Performance: Continuously test and optimise copy to improve open rates, click-through rates, and conversion rates. 

- Report on Copy Performance: Synthesise copy performance data and insights into actionable recommendations for campaign optimisation and future copy strategy. 

- Stay Up-to-Date: Keep up with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in copywriting and outbound and inbound sales strategies. 



Primary Brand Focus:

You will primarily write copy for the Canadian Indigenous Investment Forum (CIIF), a year-round investment forum that connects Indigenous-led businesses and communities with institutional investors from the UK, Europe, and North America. Visit 
 to learn more. You will also support copywriting initiatives across other client brands as needed.



Qualifications: 

- Marketing and Sales Experience: Proven understanding of marketing and sales principles and a track record of crafting copy that drives action. 

- Research Skills: Ability to conduct thorough research and synthesise information to create compelling narratives. 

- Proven Copywriting Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience in copywriting or related fields. 

- Strong Writing Skills: Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a keen eye for detail. 

- Creativity: Innovative thinker with the ability to generate unique ideas and concepts. 

- Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. 

- Time Management: Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 

- Analytical Skills: Proficient in using analytics tools to extract and measure copy performance metrics (open rates, clickthrough rates, conversion rates, and engagement data) and search visibility. 

- Data-driven Thinking Skills: Ability to interpret, evaluate, and synthesise data findings and insights to inform strategic decisions and identify patterns that drive copy and campaign improvement. 

- Product/Service Knowledge: Ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of complex product or service features and translate technical specifications into compelling, customer-centric narratives.

gigCMO is a growth consultancy that provides strategic marketing leadership to start-ups, scale-ups, and SMEs. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance our clients' digital presence and performance, we heavily rely on SEMrush for data-driven insights and strategy development. We are seeking a SEMrush Specialist to manage our SEMrush platform, analyse its data, and provide actionable recommendations to optimise our clients' digital strategies.





Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced SEMrush Specialist to oversee the management and analysis of SEMrush data, offering insights and recommendations to various internal teams. This role is critical for developing and refining SEO and digital marketing strategies, based on in-depth analysis of SEMrush data. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in using SEMrush and have a strong understanding of SEO, PPC, and competitive analysis.





Key Responsibilities:



Manage and monitor the SEMrush platform to track SEO performance, keyword rankings, and overall site health for our clients.

Analyse SEMrush data, providing detailed reports on SEO, PPC campaigns, competitor analysis, backlink profiles, and content performance.

Develop and recommend strategies for improving organic search rankings, increasing website traffic, and optimising digital marketing efforts based on SEMrush insights.

Collaborate with content, SEO, and marketing teams to align strategies with SEMrush data, ensuring all digital efforts are data-driven.

Conduct keyword research using SEMrush to identify high-potential keywords and provide recommendations for content optimisation.

Identify and track competitors' activities, providing insights on their strengths and weaknesses using SEMrush competitive analysis tools.

Stay up to date with SEMrush updates, new features, and industry trends to ensure we are maximising the platform's potential.

Generate regular reports on SEMrush performance metrics for different teams, including SEO health, keyword movements, and traffic changes.

Offer training and support to internal teams on SEMrush best practices and usage to ensure everyone is leveraging the platform effectively.

Work with teams to ensure technical SEO issues flagged by SEMrush are addressed and resolved.



Required Skills and Qualifications:



Proven experience in using SEMrush as a core tool for digital marketing analysis and strategy development.

Strong understanding of SEO, PPC, keyword research, and competitive analysis.

Ability to interpret SEMrush data and translate it into actionable insights and strategies.

Experience in creating reports and dashboards that effectively communicate SEMrush findings to various teams.

Familiarity with SEO best practices, on-page optimisation, and technical SEO.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise recommendations based on impact.

Strong communication skills to present data and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Familiarity with digital tools like HubSpot, Basecamp, and SharePoint or similar for managing workflows and collaboration.



Preferred Skills:



Experience in SEO strategy development, using SEMrush data as a foundation.

Knowledge of content marketing and its relationship to SEO performance.

Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other digital marketing tools.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a remote work environment.



Personal Attributes:



Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills.

Proactive in identifying trends and making strategic recommendations.

Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating with teams across departments.

Eager to stay up to date with the latest SEO trends, SEMrush updates, and digital marketing innovations.

This Role Is Only For People Who Already Work Inside a Continuity/Rebill Offer Operation



If you don't know what a $1 trial to $39.95/mo rebill is, stop here. If you've never logged into a CRM like 
 or Konnektive, stop here. If you've never tracked rebill rates, chargeback ratios, or LTV on a real offer, stop here. This role requires hands-on experience working inside a company that runs subscription/continuity offers.



We're a digital marketing company building a new continuity offer. We need someone who already does this work - someone who currently works at (or recently worked at) a company running rebill/subscription offers. You know how these offers are built because you help build and run them every day. You know what's working right now because you're in it right now.

- Help structure the offer - trial price, rebill price, billing cycle, cancellation terms, what the customer actually receives

- Design the funnel flow - what type of landing page (VSL, quiz, advertorial, long-form), checkout page structure, order form layout

- Plan the upsell/downsell sequence - what to offer, at what price points, in what order, one-click or separate page

- Advise on the membership area / fulfillment - what content or product goes behind the paywall, what makes customers feel they got value (reduces chargebacks)

- Recommend the right tech stack - which CRM, which payment processor, which checkout platform, based on what you use and what you've seen work

- Help us avoid the mistakes that kill offers - merchant issues, chargeback spikes, compliance problems, things you've seen go wrong

- Once live, help monitor and optimize - rebill rate, chargeback ratio, LTV, conversion rate, save rate





Application Questions



I want to see inside your world. Answer these in detail. The more specific and honest you are, the more seriously I'll take your application. I'm looking for real operational knowledge, not marketing buzzwords.





ABOUT YOUR EXPERIENCE



1. What company do you currently work for (or most recently worked for) that runs continuity/rebill offers? What is your role? What exactly do you do day-to-day? How long have you been doing this type of work?



2. Describe the offer(s) you work on. Be specific:

   - What's the niche/product? (supplements, brain health, skincare, biz-opp, finance, digital product, etc.)

   - What's the trial price and what's the rebill price?

   - What's the billing cycle? (monthly, biweekly, etc.)

   - How many days does the trial last before the first rebill?

   - Is it a physical product, digital product, or both?



3. Walk me through the customer journey on your offer from start to finish. Someone clicks an ad - then what? What pages do they see, in what order? What does the checkout look like? What happens after they buy? What
s do they get? When does the rebill hit?





ABOUT THE FUNNEL



4. What type of front-end funnel works best for your offer? (quiz, VSL, advertorial, long-form sales page, short-form, something else?) Why does that format work better than the alternatives? Have you tested different formats?



5. What does your checkout/order page look like? Single page or multi-step? Do you collect the card on the same page as the sales pitch or a separate page? Any specific elements on the checkout page that you've found increase conversions? (trust badges, guarantees, testimonials, countdown timers, etc.)



6. Describe your upsell/downsell flow. How many upsells? What are they and at what price points? Are they one-click (card already on file) or does the customer re-enter payment info? What's your upsell take rate?





ABOUT PRICING AND STRUCTURE



7. Why is your trial priced at the amount it is? Have you tested different trial prices? What happened when you went higher or lower?



8. Why is the rebill priced at the amount it is? What's the sweet spot you've found between maximizing revenue and minimizing chargebacks/cancellations?



9. How long is the trial period and why? Have you tested different trial lengths? What was the impact on rebill rate and chargeback rate?



10. What's the average LTV (lifetime value) of a customer on your offer? How many rebills does the average customer stay for before cancelling?





ABOUT RETENTION AND CHARGEBACKS



11. What's your offer's current chargeback ratio? What systems do you have in place to keep it low? (Ethoca, Verifi, pre-transaction alerts, etc.)



12. What's your rebill rate? (What percentage of trial customers make it to the first rebill? The second? The third?)



13. What do you do to reduce cancellations and keep customers rebilling? Any retention tactics, reminder
s, value-adds, membership content, etc.?



14. What does your customer service / retention team do when someone calls or
s wanting to cancel or refund? Do you have a save flow? What does it look like?





ABOUT THE TECH STACK



15. What CRM/order management system does your offer run on? (
, Konnektive, Limelight, CheckoutChamp, Shopify, custom, etc.) What do you like and dislike about it?



16. What payment processor(s) do you use? Do you use load balancing across multiple MIDs? How many merchant accounts does your offer run on?



17. What landing page / funnel builder do you use? (ClickFunnels, custom-built, WordPress, Shopify, etc.)



18. What other tools are in your stack? 
 platform, SMS, tracking, analytics, fulfillment, etc.)





ABOUT TRAFFIC



19. What traffic sources drive your offer? (Meta/Facebook, Google, native ads, YouTube,
, affiliates, etc.) Which one performs best and why?



20. What does a winning ad look like for your offer? What angles and hooks work? What creative format converts best? (video, image, carousel, UGC, etc.)



21. Do you work with affiliates? If yes, how do you structure affiliate payouts on a continuity offer? CPA, revshare, hybrid? What CPA or revshare rate?





ABOUT WHAT WORKS AND WHAT DOESN'T



22. If you were starting a brand new continuity offer from scratch tomorrow, what niche would you pick and why? What would the offer look like?



23. What's the biggest mistake you've seen kill a continuity offer? What happened and how could it have been prevented?



24. What's the single most important thing most people get wrong about running a continuity offer?



25. What niches or product types are hot right now in the continuity space? What's oversaturated? What's emerging?





ABOUT YOU



26. Why are you interested in part-time consulting work alongside your current role?



27. What hours are you available? What timezone are you in? When can you start?



28. Is there anything else about your experience with continuity offers that I should know?

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Financial Tracker - If You Love Numbers, This Is Your Dream Role
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "NUMBER CRUNCHER" OR IT WILL BE DELETED WITHOUT READING.





This Role Is Simple. But Only a Certain Type of Person Will Be Great At It.



You're the person who balances their personal budget for fun. You open a spreadsheet and feel calm. When a number is off by $3, you can't sleep until you find it. You don't just record things - you notice things. You see a payment is 2 days late and you're already drafting a message about it before anyone asks.



You're not a "just tell me what to do" person. You're the person who tells US what's going on. "Hey, Partner X hasn't paid their net-7 invoice and it's day 10." "Revenue shows $12,000 profit this month but only $7,400 hit the bank - here's who still owes us." That's you. You're my financial right-hand.



We're a digital marketing company. We run paid ads and generate revenue through advertising partners. Our problem is simple: our tracker says we made money, but the bank account doesn't always match. Some partners pay on net-7, some on net-15, some on net-30. We need someone who tracks every dollar - what came in, what's still owed, who's late, and where the gaps are.





What You'll Actually Do (1-2 hours per day)



- Log into our tracker (similar to ClickFlare/Redtrack) every day and pull partner-level revenue data

- Log into our bank reporting tool and check what payments actually came in

- Cross-reference Meta 
) Ads spend reports against tracker revenue

- Update a master spreadsheet daily with: partner name, payment terms, amount owed, due date, paid/unpaid status, date paid, days overdue

- Build and maintain a partner payment tracking system - labeled by payment terms (net-7, net-15, net-30), with full history

- Analyze past payment patterns - learn which partners pay on time, which are consistently late, by how many days

- Proactively flag discrepancies - if reported profit doesn't match bank balance, investigate and explain why BEFORE being asked

- Answer financial questions on demand: "Who owes us money?" "How accurate is our profit?" "Where did the money go?" - you should be able to answer these immediately with specifics, not "let me check"



This is NOT a traditional bookkeeping role. You will NOT use QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, or any mainstream accounting software. Everything runs on spreadsheets and our own internal tools. If that excites you, keep reading. If that scares you, this isn't your role.





Who You Are



You're a natural bookworm about numbers. Not because someone trained you - because that's just how your brain works. You organize things for fun. You track your own expenses in a spreadsheet because apps aren't detailed enough for you. You see patterns in data that other people miss.



You are proactive. This is the single most important trait. You don't wait for someone to ask "hey, did Partner X pay us?" - you already know, and you already flagged it. You think on your own. You take ownership of the financial picture like it's your own money.



You're accurate. Not "pretty close" accurate. Exact. You double-check. You verify. You have a system for making sure nothing slips through.



You're analytical. When the numbers don't add up, you don't shrug and move on. You dig. You trace. You find the answer.



You're organized. Your spreadsheets are clean, labeled, color-coded if needed, and anyone can understand them at a glance.





You Must Have



- Advanced spreadsheet skills - pivot tables, VLOOKUP or INDEX-MATCH, conditional formatting, building dashboards from scratch. You built these yourself, not from a template.

- Experience tracking money - whether that's accounts receivable, bookkeeping, financial ops, billing, collections, or freelance financial management. You've tracked who owes what and chased it down.

- A proactive personality - you flag issues before they become problems. You don't need to be managed.

- Strong attention to detail - you catch discrepancies others miss.

- Willingness to learn our custom tools - you'll be trained on our tracker, our bank reporting tool, and our ad platform reports. You need to be comfortable picking up new systems quickly without needing mainstream software.

- Professional English communication - you'll be sending updates and flags daily.





Bonus Points



- Familiarity with affiliate marketing, performance marketing, or digital advertising

- Experience with ad tracking platforms (ClickFlare, Redtrack, Voluum, or similar)

- Experience reconciling data across multiple sources (ad spend vs revenue vs bank deposits)

- Built payment aging reports or accounts receivable tracking systems from scratch

- Accounting or finance background (formal or self-taught - we care about ability, not degrees)





The Deal



This is a part-time role. 1-2 hours per day, sometimes less. You log in, update everything, flag what needs flagging, and you're done. Some days it's 30 minutes. Some days it's 2 hours. It depends on what's happening.



You will NOT use accounting software. Everything is spreadsheets and our internal tools. If you're the type who thinks "I can build something better in Google Sheets than any software could give me" - you're our person.



You'll work directly with the owner. No layers of management. Async communication - you send your daily update, flag issues as they come up, and respond when questions come in. No pointless meetings.



If you prove yourself - if you're the person who catches things before they become problems, who always has the answer, who owns the financial picture completely - this role can grow. We reward results, not hours.





Application Questions



Answer ALL of these. Real answers, not generic fluff. We can tell the difference.



1. Describe your experience tracking money. What systems did you use? What did you personally track and manage? Be specific - amounts, number of partners/clients, payment terms you dealt with.



2. Tell me about a time you caught a financial discrepancy that nobody else noticed. What was it, how did you find it, and what happened?



3. What does your ideal spreadsheet setup look like for tracking who owes you money? Describe the columns, the formulas, and how you'd organize it. Don't be vague.



4. How do you stay organized when tracking payments from multiple partners with different payment terms (some pay weekly, some biweekly, some monthly)? Walk me through your system.



5. If I told you "our tracker shows $15,000 profit this month but only $9,000 is in the bank" - what would you do? Walk me through your investigation process step by step.



6. Rate yourself 1-10 on each (be honest): Excel/Google Sheets, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, building dashboards, data reconciliation, accounts receivable tracking.



7. Have you ever used any ad tracking platforms, affiliate platforms, or digital marketing tools? If yes, which ones and what did you do with them?



8. Tell me about a tracking system, spreadsheet, or workflow you built from scratch to solve a problem nobody gave you a template for. What was the problem, what did you build, and how did it make things more efficient?



9. Are you comfortable working with custom tools you've never seen before, with minimal training? Give an example of a new system you learned quickly.



10. What hours are you available? What timezone are you in? When can you start?

description:
About Fusion Vine

Fusion Vine is a remote-first company focused on building efficient, scalable systems that help businesses grow through smart operations, content, and digital execution. We specialize in combining human talent with AI-powered workflows to deliver high-quality results at scale.



Our team values clarity, accountability, continuous improvement, and performance-based growth. We work with clear processes, defined expectations, and a strong focus on outcomes.



Role Overview

Fusion Vine is hiring a Content Specialist to help scale content production through AI-assisted workflows. This role is ideal for motivated writers who can combine strong English skills with critical thinking and smart use of AI tools. Entry-level candidates are welcome: if you can think critically and move fast, we can work with you.



Key Goal

Produce high-quality, accurate, and well-structured content at speed: using AI as a tool, not a shortcut: while maintaining clarity, brand voice, and defined quality standards.



Responsibilities

Write and deliver content using AI models as a writing aid, not a replacement for judgment

Critically review and refine AI-generated drafts for readability, accuracy, tone, and structure

Fact-check content and ensure it meets quality standards before submission

Follow content briefs, SOPs, and style guidelines closely

Complete assigned article bundles within agreed timelines

Edit for grammar, readability, and proper formatting

Stay productive and proactive: do not wait to be pushed into tasks



Requirements

Strong English proficiency: written and reading comprehension

Ability to think critically and improve AI-generated content rather than copy it blindly

Self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency and follow-through

Reliable internet connection and a suitable work device

Ability to follow instructions, briefs, and feedback closely

Critical thinking and troubleshooting is essential

Comfortable using AI tools for content creation and editing

Entry-level candidates accepted: hustle and critical thinking matter more than years of experience



Nice to Have

Foundational knowledge or genuine interest in the topics being covered

Experience with SEO content writing

Familiarity with content management systems

Background in marketing, blogs, or long-form content

Prior experience working in a remote or freelance setting



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Speed of delivery: complete article bundles quickly and on schedule (e.g., 15 articles in 2 days, not 2 weeks)

Quality of output: submit polished, reviewed content that meets defined completion criteria

Critical thinking: demonstrate genuine review and refinement of AI outputs, not blind copy-paste

Responsiveness: jump into assigned projects immediately without delay

Consistency: maintain steady, reliable output throughout the trial period and beyond



Compensation

$3.50 – $5.00 per hour (we have 1 month trial worth of $3/hour, converting it to $5/hour after 1 month)

Rate determined based on experience, skills, and performance during the trial period

Piecework/bundle-based structure: payment upon completion of each assigned bundle

One-month trial period to assess fit and performance

Opportunity to increase rate and expand hours after a successful trial



Why Join Fusion Vine?

Fully remote work environment

Clear systems, expectations, and feedback from day one

Performance-based growth: your results determine your opportunities

Hands-on experience with AI-powered content workflows

Opportunity for long-term partnership if the trial goes well

Entry-level friendly: we value drive and quality output over credentials

title: Part-Time Customer Retention Specialist - Continuity/Rebill Experience Required
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "SAVE SPECIALIST" OR IT WILL BE DELETED WITHOUT READING.





If You've Never Worked Continuity Offers, This Isn't For You. Keep Scrolling.



This posting is for a very specific type of person. You already know what a $1 trial to $40/mo rebill looks like. You've handled the angry
s. You've talked someone down from calling their bank. You have a folder of save scripts you've built and refined over the years. You know exactly what "chargeback ratio" means and you've kept one under 1%.



If none of that makes sense to you, this role is not a fit. No hard feelings.



If you're nodding along because you've lived this for the last 2+ years - read on.





What This Role Is



We run a digital product with a trial-to-subscription model. Customers sign up for a low-cost trial, it renews at a higher monthly rate, and some of them miss the cancellation window. They
 us angry. Your job is to handle those
s.



But "handle" doesn't mean "refund everyone." Your job is to SAVE revenue while keeping our chargeback ratio near zero. That means:



- When someone is just upset: deploy your save script. Cancel their recurring charges. Offer them our members-only area for free - which is genuinely high-value with a ton of real content. Keep the charge. Most people accept this and move on happy.

- When someone is threatening their bank: refund immediately. A chargeback costs us the charge PLUS a fee PLUS damages our merchant ratio. A refund is always cheaper than a chargeback. You need to read between the lines and know the difference.

- When someone is on the fence: partial refund + cancel recurring + members area access. Meet them in the middle.



The outcome hierarchy you must internalize:

SAVE is best. Partial refund is next. Full refund is better than a chargeback. Chargeback is the worst outcome - always.





What You'll Actually Do (1-2 hours per day)



- Handle 5-10
 tickets per day from customers wanting refunds on their subscription charge

- Use your proven save scripts, adapted to our specific product and members area offer

- Make judgment calls on every ticket: save, partial refund, full refund, or escalate

- Mark refund decisions in the system (someone else processes the actual refund)

- Track your save rate, refund rate, and flag any chargeback risk patterns you spot

- Build our entire CS retention system from scratch in your first week:
 templates, response workflows, escalation tiers, refund decision tree

- Flag trends proactively - if a certain traffic source is generating more complaints, if a specific charge amount triggers more disputes, if response time is affecting save rate - tell us before we ask



This is
 only right now. No phone, no live chat.





What You Must Bring To The Table



This is not a "we'll train you" role. We need someone who trains US. You must already have:



- Real, proven experience handling retention/save
s for continuity or rebill subscription products. Not general customer service. Not e-commerce returns. Specifically trial-to-rebill or subscription retention. If you've worked for a supplement company, info-product company, health offer, or any direct response business running continuity - you know what this is.



- Your own save scripts and templates. You've built these over time. You know what works. You can adapt them to our product in a day. If I asked you to show me your best save
 right now, you could pull it up.



- Deep understanding of chargebacks. You know what Visa and Mastercard thresholds are. You know the difference between a first chargeback and a pre-arbitration. You know why keeping the ratio under 1% matters more than any single refund decision. You've worked with or at least understand alert services like Ethoca or Verifi.



- Judgment. You can read an angry
 and instantly categorize it: this person is just venting (saveable), this person is about to call their bank (refund now), this person is fishing for a freebie (hold firm). You don't follow scripts blindly - you read the situation and adapt.



- The ability to build systems. We don't have a CS playbook yet. You're building it. Templates, workflows, escalation rules, tracking - you've done this before at another company and you can do it here.



- Professional, calm, empathetic written English. Your
s need to sound like a real human who genuinely cares, while firmly guiding toward the save outcome. Not robotic. Not aggressive. Not apologetic to the point of giving everything away.





Bonus Points



- Experience specifically with trial-to-rebill offers (the exact model we run)

- Familiarity with payment processors like 
, Konnektive, NMI, or similar

- Experience with chargeback alert services (Ethoca, Verifi/CDRN)

- You've trained other CS reps on retention scripts

- You track your own save rate and can tell me what it was at your last role

- Experience with health, supplement, or info-product continuity offers





The Deal



Part-time. 1-2 hours per day handling 5-10 tickets. Some days lighter, some days heavier. One product for now - could expand if you're great.



You work directly with the owner. No middle management. You send your daily ticket summary, flag any risks, and handle your queue. Async communication - no pointless meetings.



If you're the person who already has the playbook and just needs a new inbox to apply it to, this is the easiest part-time gig you'll ever have. You've done this a thousand times. The only difference is our product.





Application Questions



Answer ALL of these. I'm looking for proof you've done this before. I want to see your actual work - real
s you've sent, real scripts you use. Not summaries of what you'd do. The actual words you send to customers. If you've done this job, you have these ready. If you don't, this isn't the right role.



1. What continuity/rebill products have you handled retention for? Be specific - what was the product, what was the trial/rebill structure, how many tickets per day, and what was your save rate?



2. Show me your canned
s. Paste the ACTUAL
 templates you use for each of these scenarios (not a description of what you'd say - the real
, word for word, as you'd send it to a customer):



   a) A customer
s asking what a charge is on their card. They're not angry yet, just confused. Paste your actual response.



   b) A customer demands a full refund. They're angry but not threatening anything specific. They just want their money back. Paste your actual save
 - the one that keeps the charge and makes them happy with the membership instead.



   c) A customer says "This is fraud. I never signed up for this. I'm disputing this with my bank and reporting you to the FTC/BBB." Paste your actual response to this type of
.



   d) A customer already got your first response but
s back still demanding a refund - they rejected the save offer. Paste your actual follow-up / escalation
.



   e) A customer is polite but firm: "I appreciate the offer but I really just want my money back. Please process the refund." Paste how you actually handle this one.



   f) Any other scenario-specific templates you use regularly that I haven't listed above. Show me everything you've got. The more templates you paste, the more I can see you've actually done this.



3. What is a chargeback ratio and why does it matter? What threshold gets a merchant account flagged? What have you personally done at previous roles to keep it under control?



4. What's the difference between a customer you should save and a customer you should refund immediately? How do you tell the difference just from reading their
?



5. Describe a CS retention system you built from scratch. What templates did you create, how did you structure escalation tiers, and how did you track results?



6. What payment processors or CRM systems have you worked with? (
, Konnektive, NMI, Shopify, etc.)



7. What was the highest volume of tickets you've handled in a day? How did you maintain quality at volume?



8. Have you trained other CS reps on retention scripts? If yes, how did you structure the training?



9. What's your save rate at your current or most recent role? How do you track it?



10. What hours are you available? What timezone are you in? When can you start?

US$400/month base + US$25 for every appointment that shows up. Uncapped. Paid monthly.

20 seen appointments = US$500 commission = US$900/month

30 seen appointments = US$750 commission = US$1,150/month

40 seen appointments = US$1,000 commission = US$1,400/month



There is no cap. Every appointment that shows up puts money in your pocket. Full-time hours, more prospecting, more appointments — more money. You control your income. Commissions are paid at the start of every month, like clockwork.

And the longevity is real: deliver the appointments each month and this seat is yours for years.

Run and grow our LinkedIn presence — profiles maintained, active, and sharp every single day

World-class LinkedIn content, visual and written — posts that build authority, get replies, and start conversations

A competitive monthly salary



Quarterly performance bonuses tied to real results



A genuine long-term, full-time role with a growing business — not project work



Fully remote

Send us the following, in this order:



Your CV



Evidence of your SEO results — the actual sites you worked on, what you did, and the numbers (before and after). Australia, NZ, UK, or US clients only. Finance or real estate is exactly what we want to see.



Two or three examples of backlinks you've earned through outreach or partnerships — the linking site and how the relationship came about

You will act as a trusted extension of the CFO, helping manage critical financial processes and maintaining accuracy across payroll and reporting workflows.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, learns quickly, and can confidently navigate both executive-level responsibilities and financial operations. Who We Are Looking For



Required Qualifications

- Experience supporting senior leaders, executives, or finance leadership teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Exposure to budgeting, reconciliations, reporting, or financial analysis

- Experience in remote, startup, tech, or high-growth business environments



Core Competencies

- High Cognitive Ability

- We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

- Strong analytical thinking

- Excellent judgment and decision-making

- Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly

- Strong problem-solving capabilities

- Ability to connect information across multiple business functions



Ownership Mentality

Exceptional Attention to Detail

Organization & Prioritization

- Able to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously

Technology & Tools

- You should be comfortable working with:

- Google Workspace

- Dedicated home office or quiet work environment

Why This Role

Monitor and respond to client messages on Slack and Microsoft Teams, with live coverage during the daily US overlap window and 8 to 10 hour response time outside of it

Use our SOPs and account context to respond to routine account questions independently

Coordinate with our internal campaign team to surface client requests and deliver answers

Escalate strategic decisions and complex issues directly to the founder

2 to 4 years working with US Amazon clients at an agency or in-house at an Amazon brand

Long-term mindset. You want stability, growth, and a team that values you

Outside this window, all client messages must be answered within 8-10 hours. Rest of your working hours are flexible during Philippines day.



What we offer:

Direct working relationship with the founder

Small team where your work is seen and your voice matters

A client messages you on Slack saying "Our ACoS jumped this week, what's going on?". You haven't looked at the data yet. What's your first reply to them, and why?



Attach your resume along with the Loom link. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. We'll respond to every serious submission within 5 business days. Trial task will be paid.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and mission-aligned Executive Assistant to directly support the CEO.



This role exists to protect the CEO's capacity for strategic work, including fundraising, partnerships, program expansion, and organizational growth. The Executive Assistant handles the administrative and operational infrastructure that keeps leadership moving efficiently while also serving as a key contributor to grant development and management in partnership with the organization's grant lead.



This is NOT an entry-level administrative position. We are seeking an experienced Executive Assistant who can confidently support executive leadership, manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and operate independently in a fast-paced environment. While every organization has its own processes and systems, candidates should already possess strong Executive Assistant fundamentals and experience supporting senior leaders.



SCHEDULE



* Part-time position

* Monday through Friday

* 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM EST

* Opportunity for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the organization grows



LEADING PEOPLE



You do not manage a team, but you represent the CEO's office in every interaction.



Your professionalism, responsiveness, discretion, and follow-through reflect directly on the organization's leadership. You will be trusted with sensitive information, key relationships, organizational priorities, and executive communications. This role requires maturity, professionalism, and a high level of integrity.



DELIVERING RESULTS



* CEO calendar is managed proactively with meetings scheduled, conflicts resolved, and preparation materials organized in advance.

* Follow-up items from CEO meetings are tracked, assigned, and completed without requiring the CEO to reinitiate action.

* CEO inbox is actively managed with communications sorted, prioritized, and monitored to ensure timely responses.

* Active partnerships, grants, and community relationships are maintained in a living tracking system with current status updates and next steps documented.

* Organizational priorities are coordinated across teams with the CEO informed and never surprised.

* Grant opportunities are researched and presented to leadership on a regular basis.

* Grant applications, proposals, Letters of Intent (LOIs), one-pagers, and supporting documentation are prepared, submitted, and maintained accurately and on time.

* Grant reporting requirements, compliance deadlines, and supporting records are maintained in an organized, audit-ready system.

* Leverages AI and automation tools appropriately to streamline administrative processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and quality.

* Administrative burden on leadership is measurably reduced through strong ownership and execution.



COMMUNICATION



* Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests,
 communications, and external inquiries.

* Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks.

* Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation.

* Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations.

* Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment.

* Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up.



STRATEGIC THINKING



* Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management.

* Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives.

* Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to the organization's mission and programs.

* Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.



ACCOUNTABILITY



* Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports.

* Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan.

* Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems.

* Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met.

* Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role.

* Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership.

* Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment.

* Strong organizational and project management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems.

* Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency.

* High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment.

* Strong alignment with the organization's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management.

* Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.

* Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team.

* Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms.



IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY



This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. We are seeking someone who already understands the fundamentals of executive support and can quickly contribute to the success of the CEO and organization.



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered for this position, applicants must submit all of the following:



1. A current resume that includes complete employment history with start and end dates for each position.



2. A professional portfolio showcasing relevant work, accomplishments, projects, or case studies that demonstrate Executive Assistant, operations, project coordination, executive support, or organizational management experience.



3. A detailed introduction video that includes:



* Your Executive Assistant experience

* The executives or leaders you have supported

* Examples of complex responsibilities you have managed

* Why are you interested in this opportunity

* Why do you believe you are a strong fit for this role



4. Must use at least 10 apply points to be considered.



Applications that do not include all three required components will not be reviewed. Attention to detail is critical in this role, and complete application submissions are part of the evaluation process.

title: Performance Accountability Coach
description:
Performance Accountability Assistant (Live Google Call)



I am looking for someone to help me follow my trading process during my morning trading sessions.



This is NOT a trading job.



You do NOT need to know anything about stocks, futures, forex, or investing.



Your job is to help me follow rules that I have already created.



You are acting as an accountability partner whose only responsibility is making sure I do not violate my trading process.



Schedule

Monday-Friday - 5:30 am to 9:30 am PACIFIC standard TIme..

Approximately 3-4 hours each morning -- You will be paid for 4 hours of work, even if I am done with my morning in 15 minutes.

Live Google video call

Must speak fluent English

Responsibilities

Stay on Google chat during my trading session.

Follow a written checklist that I provide.

Ask me specific questions before every trade.

Tell me when I am breaking my rules.

Require me to stop and take a 5-minute break when necessary.

Start timers during mandatory cooldown periods.

Have me stand up, stretch, do breathing exercises, pushups, or walk away from the computer when I become emotionally reactive.

Tell me when my trading session is over according to my rules.

Have me take screenshots at the end of each session.

Record whether I followed my process.

You are NOT responsible for:

Giving trading advice

Predicting the market

Suggesting trades

Learning trading



Your only job is helping me stay disciplined and accountable.



Ideal Candidate

Assertive personality

Comfortable telling someone "No"

Comfortable enforcing rules consistently

Good spoken English

Reliable internet connection

Comfortable being on Google for several hours



If you have experience in coaching, fitness coaching, executive assistance, military, education.. This is a plus..







This job is about ACCOUNTABILITY



If I argue with you...



If I tell you "just one more trade"...



If I become emotional...



Your job is NOT to agree with me.



Your job is to remind me of my rules and enforce them.



I am hiring you specifically because I want someone who will hold me accountable. This will lead to bigger opportunities in the future.

title: Executive Assistant to the Chief Operating Officer
description:
Please apply on the link below:







What We Offer

- Starting salary of $1,300+/month USD, with room to grow based on demonstrated experience and judgment

The Role

Be the Second Brain to a Senior Executive at a Fast-Growing Creator Agency | $1,300+/month | 100% Remote, Philippines.



The COO of this agency is at capacity. He's currently doing all of it himself -- updating trackers, chasing people, drafting documents, building workflows, managing calendar conflicts, thinking through hard conversations alone. Every hour spent on that is an hour not spent on the work only a COO can do. This is the role that fixes that.



We're hiring an Executive Assistant who can absorb the COO's recurring admin and execution load, at high volume, at speed, and to a standard he can trust without checking. You'll own the doing so he can own the d
. This is not a hand-holding role. You'll be trained early, then trusted to run your lane.



The right person for this seat doesn't wait to be told the next step. They take the brief and run. They see the work that needs doing before being asked. And they're the kind of operator a COO can hand something off to and consider it handled.





What You'll Own

- Project and tracker management. Keep all the COO's project trackers and statuses current in Airtable. Maintain visibility on what's moving, what's stuck, and what's due. Nothing falls through.

- Follow-ups and chasing. Own the follow-up loop end-to-end. Chase outstanding items, send the reminders, surface blockers to the COO before they become problems.

- Document drafting. Draft documents the COO would otherwise write himself; to a standard he can route straight for approval without rewriting.

- Workflow builds in ProcessStreet. Build straightforward, repeatable workflows so the COO doesn't have to. Examples: one-off task workflows, leave handoff workflows where leave isn't approved until a handoff plan is filled out and routed.

- Process builds for capacity-constrained department heads. When a department head is buried, build their process for them under the COO's direction. Example: standing up a hiring or onboarding workflow when the owner is buried in interviews.

- Calendar and scheduling. Manage the COO's calendar, resolve meeting overlaps, find times that work across multiple people's schedules.

- Thinking partner. Act as a sounding board on draining or tricky calls. Offer a different angle on how to approach a hard conversation. Handle the legwork of putting things into Claude for the COO.





What You Bring:

Experience (non-negotiable)

- Prior experience as an EA to a senior executive. We want someone who already understands the cadence of supporting an exec at this level; not someone learning it for the first time.

- Comfortable operating at pace across many small parallel tasks. This role is high-volume throughput, not deep specialist work.

Skills (must-have)

- Project and tracker management, hands-on with Airtable

- Strong follow-up discipline; you don't need to be told twice

- Document drafting to a standard a senior executive can route without edits

- ProcessStreet workflow building from a brief

- Calendar management across multiple people's schedules

- Proficient in Claude and AI tools as part of your daily workflow

- Native English



Personality and culture fit (non-negotiable)

- Self-starter. Takes the brief and runs.

- A useful second brain: Offers a different perspective on how to approach a tricky conversation, not just executes the task

- Discreet and trustworthy. You'll see contracts, compensation conversations, and sensitive internal decisions

- Reliable enough that the COO can hand something off and consider it done





Location & Hours

100% remote, based in the Philippines.

Full-time (8 hours/day, 5 days/week) with strong overlap on the COO's working hours.



How You'll Be Measured

- This role is measured on how much load it reliably takes off the COO and how cleanly the work gets done. Specific KPIs and targets are set quarterly with the COO, but the core measures are:

- Task turnaround — speed and reliability on items the COO hands off

- Tracker accuracy and freshness — project trackers stay current, accurate, and trusted as a single source of truth

- Follow-up completion — outstanding items chased to closure, blockers surfaced early

- COO time reclaimed — the headline outcome. How much of the COO's week is freed from admin back into strategic work.

Meet turnaround times and maintain file compliance

Experience across the full range: PAYG, self-employed, investment lending, and SMSF loans



Deep working knowledge of Australian lender policy and serviceability

Familiarity with Salestrekker, AOL, and Quickli strongly preferred



Excellent written and spoken English

Up to PHP 100,000/month — we pay properly for genuine experience



100% remote, permanent full-time



Day shift only, aligned with Western Australia



Real files, real complexity, working directly with experienced Australian brokers



Long-term role with genuine opportunity for growth as the business scales



Supportive, professional, down-to-earth team

Your updated resume



A short cover letter covering: which Australian brokerage(s) you worked for and for how long, the types of files you assessed (with self-employed and SMSF specifics), and the lenders and tools you worked with day-to-day
