title: Data Management & Business Development Assistant
description:
Role Purpose

The Data Management & Business Development Assistant supports the company systems migration, information governance, documentation buildout, platform operations, photo organization, and business development workflows. The role helps keep company information clean, usable, searchable, and ready for operations, training, reporting, and handoff.



Role Overview

This role is a structured production and support role within the Data Team. It combines data management, ODQ/information governance support, system documentation, file and photo organization, platform support, and business development tracking. The role works alongside the Executive Operations & Governance Officer but does not replace directive ownership, leadership decision-making, legal/accounting review, or department owner accountability.





Core Responsibilities

1. Data Management, ODQ, and Information Governance

Support data cleanup, naming standards, file organization, tracker cleanup, and structured data management.

• Populate and update systems columns, registers, trackers, document library records, and Site Asset records.

• Identify blanks, duplicates, broken links, inconsistent naming, missing owners, stale items, and unclear records.

• Create ODQ exception lists and correction queues for leadership, Zeny, or true Owner review.



2. Overview Guides, SOPs, and System Documentation

• Draft and maintain Operational Domain Guides, Domain Packets, Division/Function Packets, folder guides, document library overviews, and system guides.

• Assist with SharePoint tracker/list/item SOPs, Slack Chat Guides, Slack file download procedures, application/platform SOPs, departmental systems overviews, and company-wide systems overviews.

• Maintain or support the OPS - SOP Index and related guide inventories.



3. Policies & Procedures Support

• Compile, organize, and index policy and procedure materials.

• Build policy and procedure inventories and identify missing, outdated, incomplete, or unapproved materials.

• Create crosswalks linking policies to SOPs, forms, trackers, document libraries, training materials, and responsible Owners.

• Route substantive policy questions for leadership, legal, HR, accounting, compliance, or true Owner review.



4. Training & Development Library

• Build and maintain the Training & Development Catalogue.

• Organize training materials by role, system, department, function, and operating process.

• Support New Staff Onboarding, Data Team Training, Business Development Training, and STR Platform Training packets.

• Link SOPs, guides, videos, checklists, and trackers to the relevant training paths.



5. Gallery and Photo File Organization

• Organize photo files by property, unit, room/area, project, date, and use case.

• Apply naming conventions and metadata standards to photo assets.

• Create gallery indexes, marketing/ad-ready photo sets, before/after project sets, and cleanup lists for duplicates or unusable photos.



6. Business Development Support

• Support LPM/LPCD contractor lead generation, tenant/rental lead generation, and related tracker maintenance.

• Build and update contractor lead lists, outreach trackers, qualification checklists, rental lead trackers, and follow-up queues.

• Draft routine outreach or follow-up messages using approved scripts/templates when authorized.



7. LPM Platform, STR, and Rental Ad Support

• Support listing accuracy, approved content updates, inquiry tracking, and platform records for Airbnb, VRBO, Zillow, and rental ad platforms.

• Monitor assigned platform queues, guest/rental inquiries, reviews, listing issues, and follow-up needs.

• Draft or send routine guest/rental responses only within approved templates and authority levels.

• Create or update platform SOPs and issue lists.



Authority Limits

• May organize, update, clean, compile, draft, track, and report within assigned systems and projects.

• May not independently approve refunds, discounts, lease terms, tenant approvals/denials, guest disputes, legal notices, HR matters, policy exceptions, high-dollar commitments, or sensitive business decisions.

• May not make final decisions on source-of-truth conflicts, system architecture, permissions, legal/accounting positions, or department ownership disputes.

• Final approval remains with the CEO, Systems/Admin Leadership, legal/accounting reviewer, department Owner, or designated true Owner.



What Success Looks Like

• Registers, trackers, site assets, and systems columns are cleaner, more complete, and easier to audit.

• Overview guides, SOPs, training materials, and policy/procedure inventories are organized and usable.

• Photo assets are structured, searchable, and ready for operational, rental, STR, and marketing use.

• Business development trackers and platform records are current, clear, and ready for follow-up.

• Zeny and leadership can quickly see blockers, missing data, unclear ownership, and items needing review.



Confidentiality and Judgment

This role may involve access to operational, property, tenant, contractor, guest, vendor, financial, legal, systems, platform, and internal company information. The employee must maintain confidentiality, follow assigned authority limits, protect company information, and escalate sensitive or unclear matters rather than making unauthorized commitments.

Job Title: Product & Packaging Designer — Korean Beauty Brand (Freelance / Part-Time, Remote)

Read the full post before applying.



About Us

AÉRA is a Korean-inspired lash and beauty brand based in Adelaide, Australia. We are launching a product line of Korean lash lift solutions, serums, and accessories — sold through our Shopify store and wholesale to lash artists. Our aesthetic is clean, minimal, and premium — think Korean beauty meets clinical precision. Quiet luxury, not loud.

We are building the full product packaging suite from scratch and need a talented designer who can bring this vision to life across boxes, labels, and brand collateral.



The Role

We need a Product & Packaging Designer to design and produce print-ready artwork for our lash lift product range — boxes, labels, inserts, and brand collateral. You will work closely with the founder to translate the AÉRA brand identity into physical product packaging that is both beautiful and manufacturer-ready.

This is a freelance or part-time ongoing role. We have multiple SKUs launching and will need continued design support as the range grows.

Hours: Project-based to start, potential ongoing retainer

Rate: USD $5–12/hr or per-project rate — open to negotiation based on portfolio

Start: ASAP

Location: Remote — Philippines or anywhere

Packaging Design (Primary Focus)



Design product boxes for lash lift solutions, serums, and accessories — print-ready files

Create inserts, instruction cards, and thank-you cards

Prepare dieline templates and work with manufacturer specifications

Set up files correctly for print — CMYK, bleed, crop marks, correct resolution

Revise artwork based on manufacturer or founder feedback

Organise and maintain all design files in shared Google Drive



Brand & Business Design

Create wholesale order forms, price lists, and lookbooks in a clean branded layout

Design certificates or completion cards for the masterclass

Business documents — media kits, brand decks, supplier presentation slides



Canva (Bonus — Not Required)



Recreate key brand templates in Canva for the social media VA to use

Set up Canva brand kit with correct fonts, colours, and logo files

Design Canva templates for Instagram posts, Stories, carousels, and
 headers





Must-Haves



Proficient in Adobe Illustrator — this is non-negotiable, it is the primary tool for this role

Experience in product packaging or label design — must show examples in portfolio

Understands print production — CMYK, bleed, crop marks, dielines, resolution

Strong eye for clean, minimal, premium aesthetics — Korean beauty references are a plus

Can work from a brand identity brief and interpret direction independently

Organised with files — properly named, layered, export-ready

Communicates clearly about timelines and revision rounds

Adobe Acrobat or PDF export for print-ready deliverables



Nice to Have



Adobe Photoshop and InDesign experience

Canva proficient — can build templates from existing brand identity

Experience designing for beauty, skincare, or wellness brands

Familiar with Korean or Japanese minimalist design aesthetics

Experience preparing files for OEM or contract manufacturers



Tools: Adobe Illustrator · Adobe Photoshop · Adobe InDesign · Google Drive · Canva (bonus)



Portfolio Requirements

This role is entirely portfolio-based. We will not interview candidates without a strong portfolio.

Your portfolio must include:



At least 2 product packaging examples — boxes, labels, tubes, pouches, or similar

At least 1 example showing print-ready setup — dieline, bleed, crop marks visible

Evidence of clean, minimal aesthetic — not busy or heavily illustrated styles



Beauty, skincare, or wellness packaging is highly preferred. FMCG, food, or pharmaceutical packaging is also acceptable.



How to Apply

: [your
]

Subject line: AÉRA Designer Application — [Your Name]

Whether you have Canva experience (yes/no)

Your availability and hourly or project rate

Your timezone

Good pool of Filipino designers, lower ratesBehance Job BoardDesigners actively looking, portfolio already visibleUpworkFilter by "packaging design" + "Adobe Illustrator" + "beauty&quot
 Groups"Filipino Freelancers", "PH Graphic Designers" — post directly, fast responses

title: Relationship Officer / Producer - 37 Projects
description:
About 37 Projects



37 Projects is a full-service YouTube growth strategy agency for health, wellness, nutrition, and fitness podcasters. We're not a video editing company - we're a growth partner. We design content for performance *before* it's even recorded, and we've helped channels go from a few thousand subscribers to hundreds of thousands by treating YouTube growth as a strategy problem, not a production problem.



Our clients trust us with their channels because we don't just publish - we grow. "Making an Impact, One Project at a Time."



---



The Role



We're hiring a Relationship Officer / Producer - the client's main point of contact and the connective tissue between our clients and our production team.



You'll own the relationship end-to-end: attending client meetings, understanding where their channel is headed, translating their goals and feedback into clear direction for our editors, content managers, and production leads and making sure nothing gets lost in translation along the way.



This is not a passive account management role. You'll need to push back when a client's ask is vague or off-strategy, ask the right follow-up questions, and hold both the client and the internal team accountable to timelines and quality.



---



What You'll Do

- Be the primary client contact. Manage day-to-day communication for your assigned clients:
, Slack, and scheduled calls.

- Attend client meetings. Sit in on strategy and check-in calls to understand the channel's growth trajectory, upcoming topics, guest lineups, and content direction.

- Push back constructively. Don't just relay whatever a client says - clarify vague requests, flag unrealistic timelines, and ask the questions that actually get us the information we need.

- Translate client input into actionable detail. Take everything fro
etings and
s and convert it into clear, detailed handoff forms/briefs for the Production and Content teams - topics, guest context, footage notes, priorities, deadlines.

- Own the handoff, not the execution. Pass fully-detailed briefs to the Head of Production and Head of Content. You are the bridge - you don't touch internal trackers, editing, or content planning directly.

- Track channel context over time. Understand each client's growth, past performance, and content history well enough to speak to it confidently on calls without needing to be briefed every time.

- Escalate the right issues to the right people. Know when something is a production issue vs. a content/strategy issue, and route it accordingly instead of trying to solve everything yourself.

- Deliver corrections and updates to clients once they've been reviewed and approved internally.

title: Video Editor

Video Editor — Peakfinity Labs

## About Peakfinity Labs



Peakfinity Labs is a manufacturing company focused on supplements and cosmetics. We're looking for a talented Video Editor to help us tell our story — from the factory floor to the finished product — through compelling, high-quality video content.



## About the Role



We're hiring a Video Editor to create engaging video content that showcases our manufacturing processes, products, and company culture. You'll work with raw footage from our facilities and turn it into polished videos for marketing, training, social media, and internal communications.



## What You'll Do



- Edit raw footage into polished, engaging videos for marketing, social media, and internal use

- Cut manufacturing/process footage into clear, compelling narratives

- Add motion graphics, text overlays, color correction, and sound design as needed

- Collaborate with the marketing team on video concepts and messaging

- Manage multiple projects and turnaround deadlines

- Organize and maintain video assets and project files



## What We're Looking For



- Proven experience editing video content (portfolio required — see below)

- Proficiency in editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Strong storytelling instincts — ability to turn raw, unscripted footage into a clear narrative

- Understanding of pacing, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics

- Comfortable working with industrial/manufacturing footage (a plus, not required)

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines



## How to Apply



To apply, please send us:



1. **Your portfolio** — a link or reel showcasing your best editing work.

2. **(Optional, but recommended) A sample edit** — To help us prioritize applications, we invite you to download raw footage from **
** and produce a short edited video (60–90 seconds) that tells a clear, engaging story using the clips provided. We want to see how you structure a narrative, pace cuts, and polish raw material — not just your software skills.



   *Tips for a strong sample edit:*

   - Choose a clear focus or theme rather than using every clip

   - Aim for a logical flow: an opening hook, a clear middle, and a satisfying close

   - Include basic color correction, clean audio, and simple titles/graphics if relevant

   - Keep it tight — quality of storytelling matters more than length



Applicants who submit a sample edit alongside their portfolio will be prioritized for review.

---



Peakfinity Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Quality Audit Assistant
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Job Type: Part-time, with Australian business hours (early start, afternoons free)

Company: WorkWise Auto Solutions

Salary: Competitive, based on experience



About the Role



WorkWise Auto Solutions runs Virtual Service Advisors who prepare jobs, quotes, and invoices for auto workshops across Australia. Before that work reaches the client, it gets checked. That is what you would do. You are the second set of eyes that makes sure every job is complete, correctly formatted, and follows the client's rules before it goes out.



This is careful, methodical work. You will review a high volume of jobs each day against a clear checklist, catch the items that were missed, write a short, clear note on what needs fixing, and log it. You do not need automotive knowledge to start. You do need to be accurate, fast, and the kind of person who follows a rule exactly every time.





Is this you?

 - You are quick and accurate with spreadsheets and data entry, even at high volume.

 - You read closely. You can pick up a client's cheatsheet and apply its rules to a new job without being walked through it each time.

 - You think logically. You cross-check information and notice when something does not add up.

 - You write clearly and briefly, so the person fixing the error knows exactly what to change.

 - You can follow a process the same way every time, without cutting corners when it gets busy.

 - You want steady, focused part-time work, not a quick gig.

A background in quality assurance, compliance, or audit is a plus, but it is not required.





What You'll Do Day to Day

 - Review and audit incoming triages and quotations for completeness and correct formatting.

 - Check each job against the client's cheatsheet and service schedule, confirming that every item due for service has been added and is reflected consistently across the checksheet, notes, invoice, and purchase order.

 - Cross-reference details against our internal trackers and databases to confirm everything is accurate and entered in the right place.

 - Flag incomplete or incorrectly formatted jobs with a clear, specific note on what needs to be fixed.

 - Keep the audit log up to date with the jobs you have reviewed, the errors found, and the patterns you are seeing.

 - Help put together short audit summaries on recurring issues, so the wider team can tighten up and improve.





A Real Example from the Role

A job comes through for a 120,000 km service. The cheatsheet says spark plugs and the air filter are due every 60,000 km, so they belong on this job. They are not on the invoice. You catch it, note exactly what is missing and where, and log it. Small miss, real consequence: without you, that workshop sends an incomplete job to its customer.

If reading that made you want to go and check the rest of the job too, you will fit in well here.





Why You'll Like It Here

 - Full training on our systems and the audit process. No automotive knowledge required to start.

 - 100% remote. Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

 - Part-time hours on an Australian day shift, so your afternoons and evenings stay yours.

 - Clear, structured work with a defined checklist, so you always know what a good job looks like.

 - Room to grow as the audit function and the company expand.

 - A supportive team that takes pride in getting the details right.



How to Apply

Applications are only reviewed through the form below, not via
 or this post.

Apply here :  
 

Select "Quality Auditor " as the position.



Two things we read first, so please don't skip them:

1. Tell us about a time you caught an error that others had missed. What were you checking, and how did you spot it?

2. Describe how you keep your accuracy up when you have a large batch of repetitive work to get through.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short practical test, where we will ask you to review sample jobs against a simple cheatsheet and flag what is wrong. It is the best way for us to see how you think.
